explanation: Federico Fellini named the film's pushy celebrity photographer Paparazzo. In the plural, his surname became the word for photographers who hound the famous.

claims.text: The word paparazzi comes from Paparazzo, a photographer character in Federico Fellini's La Dolce Vita (1960).
Roman Holiday (1953), Blow-Up (1966) and Bicycle Thieves (1948) are not the source of the word paparazzi.
Federico Fellini directed La Dolce Vita.
Paparazzi is the plural of the character's surname, Paparazzo.
